image_description: A close-up view of a polished steel breastplate (cuirass) featuring ornate etched designs and gilded accents. The armor has a high collar (gorget) and visible attachment points/straps on the shoulder. It is displayed among other historical artifacts, including what appear to be maces or club heads with leather straps in the background.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from similar classes like 'cuirass' or generic 'armor'.
To analyze the complex reflections and ensure the metallic texture does not exhibit AI-generated 'melting' or inconsistent specular highlights.
To verify the sharpness of the metal edges against the cluttered background and ensure no boundary bleeding occurs.
To ensure the background artifacts (maces/clubs) have consistent depth and do not merge structurally with the foreground armor.

focus_areas: Reflection consistency on curved metal surfaces
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the reflections on the steel. In AI images, reflections on curved metal often warp illogically or fail to mirror the surrounding environment correctly. Also, check the etched patterns; AI often blurs fine line work into smudges. Ensure the leather straps look physically attached and not just painted on.
